title: Fall of Babylon — Wikipedia

verification_log.method: Cuneiform texts say "without battle"; Briant calls this "prima facie unlikely" and Michalowski notes no contemporary evidence supports it; Herodotus and Xenophon describe a diverted river and festival; Tolini proposes a forced entry through the Enlil Gate; Belshazzar's death per Xenophon "not widely accepted"

access_notes: Its Julian date (12 Oct 539) is cited to a 2025 newspaper and a 2025 popular article, not to a chronology table; not relied on for the date.
